request: Publish the synthetic nurse-triage operations fixture to Tableau as 8 independent passthrough published data sources (one per table: patients, nurses, nurse_skills, patient_required_skills, assignments, unit_snapshots, clinical_notes, skills_reference). NO joins and NO transforms: the downstream triage analysis agent queries each table on its own LUID via the Tableau MCP and deliberately never fans the skill bridges out, so each table must stay a separate 1:1 source. The patients source is the FILTERED csv with mean_skill_match_pct removed (a validation aid that would let the agent read a planted effect off a circular column). All data is SYNTHETIC (data_classification=SYNTHETIC on every row). Target the usfederaldemos Prep Agent demo collection.

sources.name: Triage Patients
sources.description: SYNTHETIC nurse-triage fixture: one row per patient admission (acuity, diagnosis, comorbidity, length of stay, adverse-outcome flag). mean_skill_match_pct is intentionally EXCLUDED (validation aid). Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: Triage Nurses
sources.description: SYNTHETIC nurse-triage fixture: one row per nurse (home unit, certification, experience, shift pattern, max caseload, skill count). Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: Triage Nurse Skills
sources.description: SYNTHETIC nurse-triage fixture: the nurse→skill bridge (one row per nurse per skill). Kept as its own source so the analysis agent never fans it into patients or assignments. Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: Triage Patient Required Skills
sources.description: SYNTHETIC nurse-triage fixture: the patient→required-skill bridge (one row per patient per required skill). Kept separate to avoid row fan-out. Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: Triage Assignments
sources.description: SYNTHETIC nurse-triage fixture: one row per nurse×patient×shift assignment (assignment_method AI-Recommended|Manual, skill_match_pct, workload_score, caseload_at_assignment). The honest source for the skill-match analysis. Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: Triage Unit Snapshots
sources.description: SYNTHETIC nurse-triage fixture: hourly per-unit census/occupancy/ratio/risk snapshots. Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: Triage Clinical Notes
sources.description: SYNTHETIC nurse-triage fixture: free-text H&P/progress/discharge notes for some patients, internally consistent with the structured record. Advisory demo data only.

sources.name: Triage Skills Reference
sources.description: SYNTHETIC nurse-triage fixture: the skill taxonomy (skill_id → name, category). Advisory demo data only.

outputs.name: Triage Patients
outputs.description: SYNTHETIC / ADVISORY DEMO DATA — NOT real patient data. One row per patient admission for the AI-assisted nurse-assignment demo. mean_skill_match_pct is deliberately excluded so downstream analysis can't read a planted effect off a circular validation column.
